title: Comprehensive archive reanalysis
methodology: Recomputed SHA-256 for every uploaded archive
Parsed every LHA level 0/1/2 header and every ZIP central-directory entry
Decompressed every -lh0- and -lh5- payload and scanned all text-like files
Recorded -lh1- members conservatively without claiming unread source semantics
Repeated analysis for byte-identical redistributions instead of relying on previous conclusions
Classified claims as documented, observed, inferred, or unavailable
